title: Transfer - Scan Fragment Audit
goal: Inspect a noisy STL scan from a reverse-engineering session, enumerate connected components, identify the main assembly, and report fragment-count and debris-volume ratios against a cleanliness threshold.
skillBenefitRationale: `mesh-analysis` is the only essential skill because component discovery, volume measurement, and main-vs-debris separation are the core operations needed to produce the audit.
